audience: service businesses that manage bookings, staff and clients in SimplyBook.me

useCases.title: Check tomorrow's bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings of one day, then open one booking to see its service, provider and client.

useCases.title: Find open slots for a service
useCases.text: List the services and providers, then read the available time slots of one provider on one day.

useCases.title: Book a client into a slot
useCases.text: Check the available slots, then book one service with one provider. The client receives a confirmation.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking
useCases.text: Read the booking, then cancel it by id. The client may receive a cancellation message.

useCases.title: Add a client record
useCases.text: Search the clients by name, email or phone first, then add a client record if none exists.
